Design.Caption: MD12 - Seed inventory counting test data

AxFormControl.Name: WarehouseAInput
AxFormControl.Label: Warehouse A (blank = first warehouse on the configured site)

AxFormControl.Name: WarehouseBInput
AxFormControl.Label: Warehouse B (used by jobs 4 and 7; blank = auto)

AxFormControl.Name: SeedJob1Button
AxFormControl.HelpText: TC01: 1 file, 1 warehouse, 1 date, 1 item. Expect 1 journal with 1 line.

AxFormControl.Name: SeedJob2Button
AxFormControl.HelpText: TC02: 1 file, 1 warehouse, 1 date, 3 items. Expect 1 journal with 3 lines.

AxFormControl.Name: SeedJob3Button
AxFormControl.HelpText: TC03: same item on 3 vouchers. Expect 1 journal with 1 aggregated line (4+5+6=15).

AxFormControl.Name: SeedJob4Button
AxFormControl.HelpText: TC04: 1 file, 2 warehouses, 1 date. Expect 2 journals.

AxFormControl.Name: SeedJob5Button
AxFormControl.HelpText: TC05: 1 file, 1 warehouse, 2 counting dates. Expect 2 journals.

AxFormControl.Name: SeedJob6Button
AxFormControl.HelpText: TC06: 2 files, same warehouse and date. Expect 2 journals. Also use to test the FileName filter.

AxFormControl.Name: SeedJob7Button
AxFormControl.HelpText: TC07: 2 files x 2 warehouses, 1 date. Expect 4 journals.

AxFormControl.Name: SeedJob8Button
AxFormControl.HelpText: TC08: counted below on-hand. Expect 1 journal line with a negative Qty.

AxFormControl.Name: SeedJob9Button
AxFormControl.HelpText: TC15: one good group plus one bad group in the same file. Expect 1 journal posted and the bad rows left at Status = Error.

AxFormControl.Name: SeedJob10Button
AxFormControl.HelpText: TC16: 8 journal groups. Run the batch with NumOfThreads = 4 and check ProcessingGroup distribution.

AxFormControl.Name: SeedVolumeButton
AxFormControl.HelpText: Volume: about 10,000 rows in file TEST_MD12_VOL01 (50 warehouses x 2 dates x 100 items, real master data). Then run MD12 with FileName = TEST_MD12_VOL01.

AxFormControl.Name: VerifyVolumeButton
AxFormControl.HelpText: Volume: after the MD12 batch job ended, checks the latest TEST_MD12_VOL01 execution - rows New and Error, journals posted per group, lines, run lock, task times - and shows PASS or FAIL.
